description_en: Accepts and authorizes the execution of a system event operation. For a system event in the Inquiring state, this operation accepts the default action of the system event and authorizes the system to execute the default action
description_zh: 调用AcceptInquiredSystemEvent接受并授权执行系统事件操作。对问询中（Inquiring）状态的系统事件，接受系统事件的默认操作，授权系统执行默认操作
kebab_example: aliyun ecs accept-inquired-system-event --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --event-id e-2zeielxl1qzq8slb0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AcceptInquiredSystemEvent

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the system event. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 系统事件所在的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: This parameter is in invitational preview and is not publicly available
parameters.help_zh: 该参数正在邀测中，暂不支持使用
parameters.name: choice
